title: Integrate curated annotation promotion
evidence_required: FT-010-AC-005 RED: after TASK-096, the promoted_subset seam neither validates/copies a selected current annotation snapshot nor supports whole-subset deletion; GREEN: promotion stores only selected current annotation fields and one diagnostics-owned idempotent operation clears the whole subset plus promoted_at; decisive comparison: disposable selected and unselected annotations before promotion, after delete and after one repeated delete; artifact: redacted evidence under .tasks/TASK-098-T3-FT-010-W2/.
purpose: Extend the existing diagnostics-owned promoted-subset seam with the smallest validated annotation snapshot needed by later Calibration selection.
success_outcome: Only selected current annotation fields enter the promoted subset, and one diagnostics-owned idempotent whole-subset deletion removes them without an annotation-specific route or archive.
anti_goals: Do not implement ordinary retention cleanup, a public or annotation-specific deletion route, archive, history table or production activation task.
Do not implement Calibration selection UI, recommendation/run logic or automatic serving changes.
Do not delete promo rows directly, retain the whole ordinary bundle or touch production/operator data.

forbidden_scope: Production PostgreSQL/MinIO, operator/default Attempts/evidence/annotations and real participant names
Direct diagnostics mutation of promo rows, ownership-crossing cascades and public or annotation-specific deletion routes
Ordinary retention cleanup, annotation HTML routes, Calibration runs/recommendations/UI and serving settings
stop_conditions: Promotion cannot preserve only a selected validated annotation snapshot without retaining the ordinary bundle or unrelated diagnostic/session data.
Whole-subset deletion would require a new lifecycle, public route, history table or cross-owner transaction.
The protected-data deletion probe cannot use disposable synthetic state, one safe repeated delete and complete cleanup.

constraints: Build promoted_subset.annotations only from selected current owner rows and retain only the exact immutable fields in the canonical data spec.
Add one diagnostics-owned whole-subset deletion operation that clears promoted_subset and promoted_at together; a repeated delete is a no-op success and no public route or lifecycle is added.
Use disposable selected and unselected annotations with synthetic names, one safe repeated delete and complete task-owned cleanup.
invariants: Diagnostics validates and writes only its promoted-subset representation; no cascade or direct foreign write crosses ownership.
Promotion preserves only the selected immutable snapshot, never the entire ordinary bundle, Promo screenshot, technical logs, credentials or session data.
Whole-subset deletion is idempotent, clears promoted_subset and promoted_at together and never restores ordinary data.
verification_targets: Selected/unselected fixtures prove only the canonical fields from selected current annotation rows enter promoted_subset.
One delete and one repeat prove atomic field clearing, safe rerun and complete task-owned cleanup.
Ownership inspection proves no direct promo-table write, public deletion route, archive/history model, Calibration UI or serving mutation.
